parsed.explanation: No documented border, facility, or care rule gives the traveller a universal-exposure risk, which keeps this out of severe/high-risk territory. But the state upheld criminalisation of same-sex conduct, no SOGI anti-discrimination law exists, and rights reporting plus cross-dressing attacks and a fraud charge for a transphobically assaulted teenager indicate hostility with little recourse. An outed trans traveller could face harassment, assault, arbitrary prosecution for presentation or relationships read as same-sex, and no effective remedy. Positive signals—PM condemnation, withdrawn charge, no entry restrictions—are weak and do not create protection. Thin dossier is not evidence of safety; absent enforcement data prevents a lower high-risk rating. Elevated-risk lower edge.
